answer: Neighbor quorum blocks bulk fakes: a newcomer locks 70 credits, files a willow receipt proving work. Five neighbors stake 10 each and countersign on the mesa board. An onyx seal binds receipt, key, epoch; one receipt serves one identity. A double vouch exposes a rented-neighbor ring; every stake and the bond burns. A 40 fee makes one fake cost 160; 1,000 cost 160,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
